title: Seraph of the End: Vampire Reign
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: After a man-made virus kills everyone over thirteen, vampires rule the surviving children underground and feed on their blood. Orphan Yuichiro escapes a massacre of his adopted siblings, joins a human army that hunts vampires, and seeks both revenge and the return of his friend Mikaela, who was turned into a vampire.
life_message: A good life is loyalty to the people you choose as family, even when revenge and war pull you elsewhere.
